name: Sateen
description: A satin float landing every fifth cell along a fixed diagonal — the classic five-shaft sateen tie-up, laid over a ground that steps through the palette in order.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @pn(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); @match((@x + 2 * @y) % 5 == 0) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 24%; border-radius: 18%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
